name: Clicklastica
author: DigiDepot

sections.description:
Clicklastica is a free and lightweight WordPress plugin designed to discourage casual content copying on the frontend without affecting normal site functionality.

The plugin allows site owners to disable common actions used for basic copying, such as right-click saving and access to browser developer tools.

Clicklastica does not claim to provide complete protection. Instead, it focuses on discouraging non-technical users while keeping the website usable and accessible.

Features

  • Disable right-click on the frontend
  • Disable F12 and common developer tools shortcuts
sections.installation:
1. Upload the clicklastica folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Settings → Clicklastica.
  4. Enable the desired options and save the settings.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin fully protect my content?

No. Clicklastica is designed to discourage casual copying only. Advanced users can still access content through other methods.

Will this plugin affect normal visitors?

No. The plugin works quietly in the background and does not display popups, alerts, or notices.

Does this plugin track users or send data externally?

No. Clicklastica does not collect data or communicate with external servers.

Is this plugin free?

Yes. All features are completely free.
